---
title: "ZOOM account utilization"
format: pdf
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
```

Consolidate monthly Zoom .csv files and create here("data", "zoom_events.rds")

```{r}
#| echo: false

zoom_events <- list.files(
  path = here("raw-meetings"),
  pattern = "*.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  map_df(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    start_time = mdy_hms(start_time),
    end_time = hms(end_time),
    month = as.Date(floor_date(start_time, unit = "month"))
  )

write_rds(zoom_events, here("data", "zoom_events.rds"))
```


```{r}
zoom_events |>
  select(
    department,
    user_type,
    group,
    archiving,
    phone,
    vo_ip,
    x3rd_party_audio,
    video,
    screen_sharing,
    recording,
    poll,
    q_a,
    survey,
    crc,
    encryption
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  count(name, value) |>
  arrange(name, value) |>
  print(n = 500)
```
